verdict.line: You lose if you stand and trade autos into his Counter Strike into Empower combo; you win if you poke from range and never let him choose the engage.

brief.thesis: This matchup sits at 53.4% Teemo over 1195 games, but the lane's own data says solo kills go to Jax — because this is a burst-trade matchup, not an even-trade one. Jax's Q (Leap Strike) and W (Empower) form a one-cooldown all-in, and E (Counter Strike) punishes you for autoing him during it. Teemo wins by refusing that fight: poke, walk away, and never give him a stationary target.

theirWindow.when: E (Counter Strike) is up and he closes with Q
theirWindow.what: He leaps in expecting you to auto; if you do, he dodges it and stuns everyone around him, then lands an Empowered (W) auto for bonus damage. Hold your attacks, Blind him with Q (Blinding Dart) the moment the stun lands so his follow-up Empowered auto misses entirely, then disengage.

yourWindow.when: E (Counter Strike) was just used or is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: He has no stun and no attack-dodge available, so walk up and freely trade Toxic Shot (E) autos plus Q pokes — his Q (Leap Strike) alone is just a gap-close with no protection behind it.

start.why: Taken in 55.2% of 1238 games — the mana and sustain let you spam Q and E poke every window without running dry waiting out his E (Counter Strike) cooldown.

boots.why: 54.5% win rate over 607 games — the magic penetration keeps your Toxic Shot (E) ticks and Blinding Dart (Q) relevant as he stacks health from his passive, Equipment Mastery.

core.why: 58.6% win rate as the first core item — the on-hit proc adds burst to the poke trades you're forcing instead of standing fights.
DoT scaling punishes him for closing distance with Q (Leap Strike) even if he dodges your next auto with E.

he is building tanky and outscaling your raw poke damage
you need more attack speed to stack Toxic Shot (E) faster in short trade windows

runes.keystoneWhy: 52.6% win rate at 34.3% pick — rewards the poke-autos-then-retreat pattern this lane demands instead of a prolonged trade his R (Relentless Assault) would win.

summoners.why: 91.9% pick rate at 53.9% win rate — Flash lets you reposition out of Leap Strike range, and Ignite punishes any all-in he commits to since you aren't winning extended trades.

playing.title: Bait Counter Strike early
playing.detail: E (Counter Strike) is 18 seconds at rank 1 — poke with Q and E autos without engaging in melee so he's forced to either waste it dodging or eat free chip damage.

playing.title: Blind the Empowered follow-up
playing.detail: The instant his E (Counter Strike) stun lands, hit him with Q (Blinding Dart) so the Empowered (W) auto that follows misses — this is the single highest-value play in the lane.

playing.title: Never auto into his E window
playing.detail: Counter Strike dodges all basic attacks while active, so only commit autos when you've confirmed it's on cooldown.

playing.title: Kite every Leap Strike
playing.detail: Q (Leap Strike) is his only gap closer; use W (Move Quick)'s sprint to escape after baiting it out, especially before he's leveled it past rank 1 (17s cooldown).

playing.title: Walk, don't stand
playing.detail: Toxic Shot (E) ticks damage over time even through a dodged auto, so poke-and-retreat beats a standing fight against his R (Relentless Assault) attack-speed ramp.

playing.title: Zone with mushrooms
playing.detail: Drop Noxious Trap (R) on his jungle entrance or approach path so he can't free-engage without eating a slow and damage tick first.

playing.title: Play for poke, not kills
playing.detail: The data shows solo kills favor him — win the lane on wave state and item scaling with Statikk Shiv and Liandry's, not by forcing all-ins he's built to win.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and the 53.4%/1195-game numbers are measured OP.GG data from the current patch; the tactical reasoning on cooldown windows and trade patterns is my own read of the kits.

stats.opponentTip: Do not stand in range of Counter Strike (E)! Use Blinding Dart [Q] to prevent him from dealing additional damage afterwards!
